analogy.rationale: Nematocides are antiparasitic antiinfective drugs whose targets (e.g., nematode-specific ion channels or metabolic enzymes) are not expressed in human cell lines, so they should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other antiinfective/antiparasitic agents that similarly lack human targets.
